name: get_products
description: Returns a list of your products; the products are returned sorted by creation date, with the most recently created products appearing first. (GET /v1/products)

active.description: Only return products that are active or inactive (e.g., pass false to list all inactive products).

limit.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 30.
